correctness.rationale: For one raw variable p, every allowed sentence is equivalent to a constraint on k=|p| chosen from k=0, k=n, k>0, k<n, k>=n-k, k<=n-k, k>n-k, k<n-k, or is tautological/contradictory. A consistent theory therefore reduces to one strongest lower and one strongest upper bound. The 25 possible bound pairs are checked exactly and yield only the five stated spectra. Explicit theories realize all five.
